pages.text: Customizable decorations can be edited dynamically. Rotation, scaling and offsetting is supported on these objects.

Use the Customization and Rendering tools to change parameters about customizable blocks. Right click the items in the inventory to change their modes, then either shift-right/right click to change the parameter mode selected.
Translate, scale and rotate with ease
Note: Air, liquid blocks and blocks with block entities cannot be used in the Customizable Copying Decoration.
